components.summary: CI on every push and publication of one CI-checked source
responsibilities: Run the test suite, strict FlowGuard map check, release check and skill install check on every push
Check source/version/changelog identity, wait for CI success on the exact SHA, and create the stable tag and Release at that commit
side_effects: CI is read-only; an explicit release commit or manual workflow publishes with GitHub token

components.summary: Commands for checking, comparing and reading world contracts and model trees. Check outputs include raw input file digests in compact and full JSON; kernel report fields and other commands remain stable. Each command has help; timeline --full retains complete state lines.
responsibilities: Expose check, mesh-check, timeline and observation comparison through the portable CLI
Load scene/trip and story examples from portable skill assets
side_effects: Read declared CLI inputs; print a summary or the full JSON report

components.summary: Shared contracts, compact reports, clock and finite replay helpers Provide sorted relative paths and SHA-256 hashes of raw input bytes for the CLI. Timeline text starts with full state and then prints changes; full text and JSON stay available.
responsibilities: Derive required Guards from claim semantics and claim assertion kinds and validate shared contract shapes; validate event clocks, homogeneous time kinds and scenario-local event identities; own the shared per-Guard boundary semantics table and derive unmapped semantics only outside selected Guard boundaries; validate event-linked transitions, participant fields and reserved event-time names Keep node-scoped assertion semantics and clocks out of holder-local Guard derivation and time validation; reuse the canonical clock and native replay across mesh handoffs.

Provide pure event and token replay, norm activation and safe scalar scenario evaluation shared by Guards and claim assertions; expose unscoped event times in hours and replay linked token transitions in event order; activate norms from event-time fluents as well as static facts
Keep compact native reports and the conservative four-status aggregation
Apply finite in-memory variant patches by exact paths and ids; read the native event/token/scalar timeline without a separate simulation engine
Check declared event preconditions without assuming an order inside simultaneous groups; retain uncertainty after conflicting same-time writes until a definite later write.
The timeline shows every claim row with its result, every declared sub-model and every problem of the native report
side_effects: Read declared mapping files (YAML only when PyYAML is installed) and emit JSON only when requested

components.summary: Seven native domain Guards with one test-only good/bad case catalog.
responsibilities: Own native event, agent, space, resource, causal, conflict and norm rules
Preserve exact native failure codes and real good/bad regression inputs in tests
Each Guard's catalog good case passes and each catalog bad case fails with exactly its native code (model guard_semantics)
side_effects: Return native Guard results; family checks execute finite good and known-bad cases

components.summary: Unit qualification that runs the derived Guards and checks the claim assertions against the model
responsibilities: Run each derived native Guard exactly once Resolve node rows only against parent_child descendants in a native mesh context; standalone references gap and summary-only nodes need no local Guard execution.
Evaluate each claim.asserts row against the world model; a false row fails the claim, an unresolved row is a gap, and a claim without assertions is not bound (gap)
Expose one row per problem and checked Guard/claim counts with a single final status; check optional entity registries across Guard inputs; expose the run_worldguard kernel through this one owner
Require each known-bad variant to produce its expected non-pass status/code; retain source references and event prefixes on full counterexamples
Compare only supplied observations with native world event times and causal scenario values, using declared time/variable tolerances and no writes or frozen artifacts.
Decorate only mapping event and transition records so malformed native records keep their original typed Guard result. Read entity uses only from mapping event records.
A single token's place agrees with the spatial relations declared at the same time: a contradiction fails, an unrelated place is a gap
side_effects: Execute selected native Guards and return a bounded report

components.summary: One tree of contracts joined by parent_child and continues, with mesh-level variants.
responsibilities: Aggregate real child outcomes and descendant-only parent assertions
Check one rooted parent tree and state/time/value continuity
Replay declared tree variants with exact failure codes and preserve native findings
Tree lines show each node's own status, its subtree status when different, and each continues edge's result; the root line's subtree status equals the report status
state: Immutable node reports and mesh findings
side_effects: Execute declared native mesh nodes and emit in-memory evidence

components.summary: Portable skill installer and installed-copy check
responsibilities: Install the skill and copy the worldguard package into its runtime directory; check an installed copy
side_effects: install replaces the target skill copy; check and dry-run modes are read-only

components.summary: Portable skill launcher and the references it serves
responsibilities: Run the installed runtime copy when present, otherwise the repository package, without writing bytecode
Keep contract and reporting instructions aligned with the CLI
Document compare inputs, native expected values, clock/variable tolerances and observation mismatch exits in the stable contract reference.
Keep the seven-line operational entry and three runnable references within 25 KB, with model input/mesh/observation guidance and native reporting rules.
side_effects: Run only the native WorldGuard CLI

flows.summary: check a tree of world contracts
Compare a world or a mesh with observations and optionally write an independent event-time copy
Read text or JSON state evolution for one world or a whole model tree
Apply each declared known-bad tree edit and rerun the actual tree with exact status and code

accepted_debts.reason: Two statements choose the installed runtime or the repository package; LogicWriting's preflight pins them verbatim. Covered by tests/test_cli_module.py (test_repository_launcher_uses_the_repository_package, test_launcher_reads_json_without_pyyaml, test_install_skill_copies_the_skill_and_the_launcher_writes_no_bytecode).
Two workflow YAML files and no Python; the version files they publish are checked by tests/test_version.py, and CI runs the workflows themselves.
